role: visual direction and continuous presentation study; no new release gate

visual_direction.mode: iOS native reading, calm control, progressive disclosure
visual_direction.typography: SF/PingFang system; normal body17, emphasis27, title25/32; semantic Dynamic Type in native
visual_direction.note: New direction supersedes R2/R3 composition for review. Frozen historical tokens/A1 and old evidence stay intact; native maps these roles to semantic styles alongside the feature slice. Generated references approximate the palette and are not pixel specifications.

motion_engine.integration: analytic damped spring, persistent continuous value, velocity-preserving retarget

zoom.reduced_motion: fixed fit image plus opacity; no long-distance zoom

popover.anchor: trigger bounds, above/below according to available space

motion_engine.native_rule: System navigation, detents, scrolling, zoom, keyboard, material and haptics use platform behavior. Web constants are study choices, not Apple specifications or fixed native duration requirements.

review_units.component: anchored popover and object context menu
observable process + stable blocks + local comparison

invariants: gesture owner stays fixed until ended/cancelled
submit and receipt are separate from presentation
explicit continuation only populates draft in this study
persistent View/node identity for existing controls
zero replacement of user data/A1/HTTP/source manifests
limitations: browser scroll is not iOS bounce/deceleration proof
no pinch viewer or cold-start acceptance
not complete CGUI or HIL production implementation
